description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Water 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Divergent Time Flow Mode] to the user

description.name: Eidolon King's Bellow
description.text: Six single attacks (2.90 each), 3.20 each if exploiting elemental weakness, grants [Water Ability +30% Boost 1] to the user

description.name: Eidolon King's Strike
description.text: One single attack (16.40) capped at 99999, grants smart ether 2 and [Summoning Quick Cast 2] to the user

description.name: Attach Water 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Divergent Time Flow Mode
description.text: Casts Feymarch Friction after casting Eidolon King's Bellow or Eidolon King's Strike, removed after triggering three times, removed if the character hasn't [Synchro Mode]

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
